crossRefs.note: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall…
Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with…
He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.
Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken…
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
Take heed now; for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed; for Yahweh God…
I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate testified…
that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing…
“Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am…
Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was…
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations…
For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
translations.bsb: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
translations.kjv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
translations.asv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
